Executive Summary

From a brittle warehouse to a governed lakehouse

The shift is not a lift-and-shift. We move from siloed, script-driven extracts feeding a single BI tool to one open, governed platform that serves BI, data science, and AI agents from the same trusted data.

Current State

Legacy EDW
  • SOURCE Epic Clarity & Caboodle on SQL Server
  • PIPELINE IBM DataStage, T-SQL stored procedures, hand-built scripts
  • COMPUTE Scale-up SQL Server, batch-bound, nightly windows
  • ANALYTICS Tableau extracts, report sprawl, no shared model
  • AI/ML Effectively none — data not science-ready
  • GOVERNANCE Per-system, manual, hard to audit
→

Target State

Azure Lakehouse
  • SOURCE Epic (Clarity, Caboodle, FHIR/HL7) + Workday ERP
  • PIPELINE ADF + Delta Live Tables + Databricks Workflows
  • COMPUTE Elastic Spark + Photon, streaming & batch
  • ANALYTICS Power BI on a governed semantic layer
  • AI/ML Mosaic AI, MLflow, GenAI & agentic workloads
  • GOVERNANCE Unity Catalog + Purview, lineage by default
Design Tenets

Six principles that govern every decision

One source of truth

A single governed lakehouse replaces overlapping marts and extracts. Clinical and operational data share one Gold layer and one set of definitions.

Open by default

Delta Lake open format and open APIs prevent vendor lock-in. Data is consumable by Power BI, notebooks, and external apps alike.

Secure & compliant

PHI protection, HIPAA, and least-privilege access are built in through Unity Catalog, not bolted on per report.

Governed self-service

Certified semantic models let analysts and clinicians answer their own questions without re-engineering the pipeline.

AI-ready foundation

Every curated dataset is science-ready — feature stores, vector search, and agents draw from the same trusted tables.

Automate the toil

Declarative pipelines and orchestration replace fragile stored procedures and manual scripts, with quality enforced as data flows.

Current State · Narrative

Where the data lives today

Analytics today is anchored on Epic's reporting databases landing into SQL Server, transformed by a mix of DataStage jobs and stored procedures, then surfaced almost entirely through Tableau.

The stack as it stands

  • Epic Clarity — relational, normalized extract of the EHR for detailed reporting.
  • Epic Caboodle — dimensional warehouse for friendlier, faster analytics.
  • SQL Server — the central EDW where marts, snapshots, and history accumulate.
  • IBM DataStage — ETL moving and shaping source data into the warehouse.
  • Stored procedures & scripts — business logic embedded in thousands of lines of T-SQL.
  • Tableau — the primary consumption layer for dashboards and extracts.

What it costs us

  • Logic is scattered and undocumented — change is slow and risky.
  • Nightly batch windows can't keep up with near-real-time clinical demand.
  • Tableau extracts drift from source; "two numbers" disputes are common.
  • No native path to ML, GenAI, or agents on this data.
  • Operational data (finance, supply chain, HR) sits outside the warehouse.
  • Governance and PHI controls are manual and audited per system.

Legacy reference architecture

Current State · Constraints

Why the legacy estate can't take us forward

Scale

Vertical ceiling

SQL Server scales up, not out. Peak loads contend for one engine, and the nightly window is already full.

Latency

Batch-only

Clinical and operational teams increasingly need intraday data; ETL cycles deliver yesterday.

Agility

Hidden logic

Business rules live in stored procedures and DataStage jobs with little lineage, making change slow and fragile.

Trust

Metric sprawl

Tableau extracts each redefine measures, producing competing versions of the same KPI.

AI

No ML path

Data isn't structured or accessible for model training, feature engineering, or GenAI.

Scope

Clinical-only

Finance, supply chain, and HR data live outside the warehouse, blocking enterprise views.

Risk

Manual governance

PHI access and auditing are handled per system, raising compliance burden and exposure.

Cost

Fixed footprint

Licensing and hardware are sized for peak and paid for around the clock, idle or not.

Target State · North Star

One lakehouse for the whole enterprise

Azure Databricks becomes the unified platform for storage, processing, governance, and AI. Power BI is the enterprise lens. Clinical and operational workloads finally share one foundation.

Lakehouse

Target State · Data Architecture

Medallion: raw → refined → ready

Data flows through three progressively trusted layers. Quality is enforced as it moves, so consumers only ever touch certified Gold.

Layer 01
Bronze

Raw, immutable landing zone. Every source — Clarity, Caboodle, Workday, FHIR streams — ingested as-is with full history and metadata.

  • Exact source fidelity, append-only
  • Schema captured, nothing dropped
  • Replayable for reprocessing & audit
Layer 02
Silver

Cleansed, conformed, and joined. De-duplicated, validated against expectations, and standardized into an enterprise model.

  • Data quality rules enforced (DLT)
  • Patient, encounter & cost entities conformed
  • Clinical + operational data integrated
Layer 03
Gold

Business-ready, aggregated marts and semantic models. The single certified source for Power BI, ML features, and agents.

  • Curated KPIs & star schemas
  • Certified metrics — one definition
  • Feeds BI, ML, and AI alike
Bronze ⟶ Silver ⟶ Gold · governed end-to-end by Unity Catalog with column-level lineage.
Target State · Integration

Integrating with Epic — both ways

We meet Epic where it is: batch from the reporting databases for depth, and standards-based streams for timeliness — then close the loop by surfacing insight back inside clinician workflow.

Inbound · batch

Clarity & Caboodle

ADF extracts the relational and dimensional reporting databases into Bronze on a managed schedule — preserving the depth teams rely on today.

Inbound · real-time

FHIR & HL7

FHIR APIs and HL7v2 feeds stream events (ADT, orders, results) into Bronze for near-real-time clinical use cases.

Inbound · bulk

Bulk FHIR export

Population-scale FHIR export hydrates cohorts and research datasets without hammering operational systems.

Transform

Conform & map

Silver maps Epic structures to a common patient/encounter model and reconciles identifiers across sources.

Outbound

Write-back

Gold insights and model scores flow back to Epic via FHIR / interconnect so clinicians act inside their existing workflow.

Govern

PHI controls

Unity Catalog enforces de-identification, masking, and minimum-necessary access on every Epic-sourced field.

Target State · Orchestration

Declarative pipelines replace fragile scripts

The stored-procedure-and-cron tangle gives way to declarative, observable, version-controlled orchestration where data quality is enforced as part of the flow.

What changes operationally

  • Declarative, not procedural — DLT defines what good data looks like; the engine handles how.
  • Quality as code — expectations quarantine or fail bad records before they reach Gold.
  • Version-controlled — every pipeline in Git, promoted through CI/CD, not edited in production.
  • Observable — built-in lineage, run history, data-quality metrics, and alerting.
  • Elastic — compute scales to the job and spins down, replacing the fixed nightly window.
Target State · Security & Governance

Compliance built into the platform

In healthcare, governance can't be a layer you add at the dashboard. PHI protection, HIPAA alignment, and least-privilege access are enforced once, centrally, and inherited everywhere.

Unity Catalog

One permission model across all data and AI assets — catalogs, schemas, tables, models, and files — with fine-grained, attribute-based access.

Identity

Microsoft Entra ID for SSO and conditional access; groups map to roles so clinicians, analysts, and engineers see only what they should.

PHI protection

Column masking, row-level filters, and de-identified views enforce minimum-necessary access to protected health information.

Lineage & audit

Automatic end-to-end lineage and immutable audit logs answer "who accessed what" for HIPAA and internal review.

Microsoft Purview

Enterprise cataloging, classification, and sensitivity labeling unify governance across Azure and the lakehouse.

Network isolation

Private Link, VNet injection, and no-public-endpoint posture keep data on trusted, private paths.

Encryption & keys

Encryption at rest and in transit with customer-managed keys in Azure Key Vault.

Compliance posture

HIPAA-aligned controls, BAA-backed services, and policy-as-code guardrails monitored continuously.

Target State · Intelligence

Agentic & AI workloads on trusted data

Because Gold data is governed and science-ready, AI is a first-class workload — not a side project. Mosaic AI, MLflow, and agent frameworks operate directly on the lakehouse.

Platform capabilities

  • Mosaic AI — model training, fine-tuning, and serving against governed data.
  • MLflow — experiment tracking, model registry, and lifecycle management.
  • Feature store — reusable, consistent features for training and inference.
  • Vector search — retrieval over clinical notes & documents for RAG.
  • Agent framework — tool-using agents grounded in lakehouse data, governed by Unity Catalog.
  • Model serving — low-latency, monitored endpoints with guardrails.

Clinical agents

Summarize charts, surface care gaps, draft documentation, and answer clinician questions grounded in patient data.

Predictive models

Readmission, sepsis, length-of-stay, and no-show risk scored on fresh data and written back to Epic.

Operational copilots

Natural-language analytics for finance and supply chain, plus agents that automate routine data-ops tasks.

Every agent and model is governed, logged, and lineage-tracked — the same controls that protect BI protect AI.
Target State · Analytics

Power BI on a governed semantic layer

Tableau's extract sprawl is replaced by Power BI reading from certified Gold through a shared semantic model — one definition of every metric, self-service without the chaos.

Certified metrics

KPIs are defined once in the Gold semantic layer, so "readmission rate" or "cost per case" means the same thing everywhere.

Direct on lakehouse

Power BI connects to Databricks SQL — DirectQuery for live data or import for speed — no more brittle nightly extracts.

Governed self-service

Analysts and clinicians build their own reports on trusted models; governance travels with the data.

Enterprise & embedded

Standard executive and operational dashboards, plus embedded analytics inside applications and portals.

Copilot for BI

Natural-language Q&A over the semantic model lets users ask questions in plain English and get governed answers.

Migration path

Existing Tableau content is inventoried, rationalized, and rebuilt on the semantic layer — consolidating duplicates along the way.

Outcomes · Clinical

Clinical process transformation

The platform exists to change care, not just dashboards. Fresh, trusted, AI-enriched data closes the loop from insight to action inside clinical workflow.

Timeliness

Real-time signals

Streaming ADT and results power early-warning and bed-flow use cases that batch could never support.

Quality

Care-gap closure

Cohort logic and risk scores surface gaps and route them to care teams — and back into Epic.

Safety

Predictive risk

Sepsis, deterioration, and readmission models alert clinicians earlier, with explainable inputs.

Efficiency

Reduced burden

GenAI summarization and ambient documentation give time back to clinicians at the point of care.

Closed-loop workflow

Insight doesn't stop at a report. Scores and recommendations are written back to Epic via FHIR so clinicians act where they already work — and outcomes feed back to improve the models.

Research & population health

Bulk FHIR cohorts and a governed, de-identified data layer accelerate research, registries, and population-health programs without disrupting operations.

Outcomes · Operational

One platform for the non-clinical enterprise

For the first time, operational data joins clinical data on the same governed lakehouse — with Workday as the ERP system of record for finance, HR, and supply chain.

ERP

Workday

Finance, HCM, and supply-chain data ingested via Workday integrations into Bronze, conformed in Silver.

Finance

Cost & revenue

Cost-to-serve and margin analytics that join Workday financials with clinical activity — impossible in the old EDW.

Supply

Supply chain

Inventory, utilization, and demand forecasting link supply data to clinical consumption.

People

Workforce

Staffing, labor cost, and productivity analytics blend HR data with operational volumes.

Clinical + operational, joined

The Gold layer lets leaders see cost, quality, and outcomes together — cost per case, labor per encounter, supply per procedure — on one certified set of definitions.

Enterprise self-service

Finance, operations, and HR teams get governed Power BI self-service on the same platform — no separate stack, no separate governance model.

Delivery · Roadmap

A phased path, value at every step

We modernize incrementally — standing up the platform, migrating in waves, and decommissioning legacy only once parity and trust are proven.

Phase 01
Foundation
Quarters 1–2
  • Stand up Azure landing zone & Databricks
  • Unity Catalog, networking, security baseline
  • Ingest first Epic & Workday sources to Bronze
  • Establish CI/CD & governance operating model
Phase 02
Migrate
Quarters 2–4
  • Rebuild priority marts in Silver/Gold
  • Convert DataStage & stored-proc logic to DLT
  • Stand up certified semantic models
  • Launch first Power BI workloads
Phase 03
Expand
Quarters 4–6
  • Real-time FHIR/HL7 streaming use cases
  • Onboard ML, GenAI & first agents
  • Operational (Workday) analytics live
  • Migrate & consolidate Tableau content
Phase 04
Optimize
Quarters 6+
  • Decommission legacy SQL Server EDW
  • Scale agentic & closed-loop clinical workflows
  • Cost & performance optimization (FinOps)
  • Continuous governance & enablement
